aboutAuthor: Dr. Vijay Malik is a SEBI-registered analyst and physician who runs DrVijayMalik.com. He teaches retail investors a checklist-driven, forensic approach to buy quality businesses at reasonable prices.

points.heading: Perspective is the first filter
points.body: Stay invested to capture the ten best months that create most long-term returns. Write a perspective sheet that defines thesis and sell triggers before price noise tempts disposition errors.

points.heading: Approach must fit you
points.body: Value, GARP, or quality works only within your competence circle, time, and temperament overlap. Chasing fashionable approaches outside that overlap guarantees style drift and losses.

points.heading: Triage before deep dive
points.body: Screen 5,000 firms to fifty using ROCE above fifteen percent, debt-equity below one, low pledge, and self-sustainable growth. Ordering work preserves hours for forensic payoff.

points.heading: Forensics first, valuation second
points.body: Seven shenanigan signs where two reds mean automatic avoid prevent price anchoring on frauds. Only after business and integrity gates pass does margin of safety valuation traffic-light turn green.

points.heading: Business before numbers
points.body: Unorganized to organized shift, bottleneck control, and customer concentration decide durability. Numbers then triangulate ROCE, CFO conversion, and DuPont to confirm five-year consistency.

points.heading: Management is veto
points.body: Related-party cleanliness, auditor tenure, and capex to core are observable integrity proxies. Any extraction via pay or warrants is veto even if financials appear attractive.

insights: Missing the ten best months in thirty years drops 11.5 percent CAGR to 5.8 percent, the cost of timing.
Self-sustainable growth equals ROCE times retention; sales consistently above it flags leverage-funded growth.
Seven-sign dashboard where any two reds means automatic avoid irrespective of cheap P-E.
conclusion: Peaceful Investing turns investing into a ten-hour checklist per company where forensic discipline, business durability, and valuation margin of safety combine to let retail investors own quality and sleep through noise.
